Collision report, July 2, 2025, 17:48. Route 9 / Harbor St.
Vehicle 1: delivery van (Kestrel Logistics), driver L. Adair, remained at scene, sober, cooperative.
Vehicle 2: bicycle, rider M. Quinn, pronounced dead at scene.
Three witnesses: van turned right across the bike lane; driver's view obstructed by a parked truck.
Conclusion: accident. No evidence of intent. Recommendation: protected bike lane at this intersection (fourth such recommendation since 2019).
Ana Ruiz represents Eastfield. Upcoming: Ordinance 26-031 (Waterfront rezoning) — vote March 16. 'I read every message residents send me. This winter, the messages have changed.'
Meridian Holdings Ltd. Jurisdiction: undisclosed. Registered agent: Corporate Services 14. Directors: nominee. Shareholders: nominee. Subsidiaries known: 212 (list not public). Incorporated: 2009.

title: Eastfield Waterfront — Homes for the next generation

versions.body:
1,200 new homes. 30% below market. A restored Calder Mill sign in the lobby. Eastfield Waterfront honours the past and builds the future.
Media contact: Paul Navarro (@pnavarro_ngd)

Northgate Development works with many community partners to share information about Eastfield Waterfront. We expect every partner to meet the highest standards. We were not aware of any concerns regarding individual accounts.

title: Email: Renee Okafor to Paul Navarro, Jan 8 2026

versions.body:
From: renee.okafor@bl-ops.net
To: paul.navarro@northgatedev.com
Subject: CSP-EF renewal + Q1

Paul — renewal attached ($21,000 for Q1). Quick heads-up since you asked about the Quinn account: yes, the original owner passed last summer. Honestly it's our best performer — the backstory really helps engagement. We'll keep her gentle until the vote.
— R.

title: Kestrel Logistics — Who we deliver for

versions.body: Delivering for Port Calder since 1998. Proud partners: City of Port Calder, Harbor Foods, Calder General Hospital, Northgate Development, Eastfield Library, PortMart, and 300+ local businesses. 140 vans on the road every day.
